name: Italian Cake
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cream sugar and oleo, add everything else.
Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites from the 5 egg yolks. Bake 350 for 20 min in layered pans greased and floured. (3 pans)

ICING: 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, 1/2 stick oleo, 1 box powdered sugar (about 4 1/2 c. = 1 lb.), 1 tsp vanilla and 1/2 c nuts. Spread between each layer and on top.
